paraphrase: Matthew reports that, after Simon Peter confesses him as the Christ, the Son of the living God, Jesus says to him: you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my ekklēsia, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it; I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven. Textual report only: neither that Jesus said this nor that anything was conferred follows.
